subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. F sits second to the right of C. D is an immediate neighbour of E and F. A sits second to the left of B. What is the position of E with respect to C?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) F sits second to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28dd7a51a00365017a9a907596a462bf9ede6e97689251e96dc2432220e85674.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66befd5f60524358a5ea8cf74789bbb46889cf2bed74ea43dee7301240752b20.png] 

2) D is an immediate neighbour of E and F.</p
